title: Localqw6 guest lere scripst v3 By OMER
script:
-- LocalScript içinde kullanılacak
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- GUI oluşturma
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "GUEST_LERE_GUI_V2"
gui.Parent = playerGui

-- Ana çerçeve
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0.8, 0)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- Renkli arka plan
frame.Active = true -- Sürükleme için gerekli
frame.Parent = gui

-- Sürüklenebilirlik işlevi
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPos

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale,
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale,
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        update(input)
    end
end)

-- Buton oluşturma fonksiyonu
local function createButton(name, text, position, parent, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.1, 0)
    button.Position = position
    button.Text = text
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255) -- Mavi arka plan
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Parent = parent
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return button
end

-- 7. Buton: Guest Özel Gücü
createButton("GuestSpecialPower", "Guest Özel Gücü", UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.1, 0), frame, function()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        -- Rüzgar efekti ve yükseklik
        local windEffect = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", character.HumanoidRootPart)
        windEffect.Texture = "rbxassetid://12345678" -- Rüzgar efekti için ID
        windEffect.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1)
        wait(1)
        windEffect:Destroy()

        character.HumanoidRootPart.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)

        -- Kocaman top
        local ball = Instance.new("Part")
        ball.Size = Vector3.new(20, 20, 20)
        ball.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
        ball.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
        ball.Anchored = false
        ball.CanCollide = false
        ball.Parent = workspace

        wait(3)

        local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
        explosion.Position = ball.Position
        explosion.Parent = workspace
        ball:Destroy()
    end
end)

-- 8. Buton: Guest En İyi Gücü
createButton("GuestBestPower", "Guest En İyi Gücü", UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.25, 0), frame, function()
    workspace.Lighting.ClockTime = 20 -- Gece yap
    local cube = Instance.new("Part")
    cube.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    cube.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(10, 0, 0)
    cube.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
    cube.Anchored = true
    cube.Parent = workspace

    wait(2)

    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        character.Name = "Guest 666"
        for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if targetPlayer ~= player then
                targetPlayer.Character.Humanoid:TakeDamage(100)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 9. Buton: Guest 666 Yapmak
createButton("Guest666", "Guest 666 Yapmak", UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.4, 0), frame, function()
    local subFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    subFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.3, 0)
    subFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0)
    subFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
    subFrame.Parent = frame

    createButton("Sword", "Guest 666 Kılıcı", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.1, 0), subFrame, function()
        local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
        sword.Name = "Guest 666 Kılıcı"
        sword.RequiresHandle = false
        sword.Parent = player.Backpack
        sword.Activated:Connect(function()
            local target = player:GetMouse().Target
            if target and target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                target.Parent.Humanoid:TakeDamage(100)
                local fire = Instance.new("Fire", target.Parent)
                fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                wait(2)
                fire:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end)

    createButton("Summon", "Guest Çağırma", UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.1, 0), subFrame, function()
        for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(targetPlayer.Character.Head, "Guestler Lordunuz Geldi!", Enum.ChatColor.Red)
            wait(1)
            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
            explosion.Position = targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            explosion.Parent = workspace
        end
    end)

    createButton("Rain", "Guest Yağmuru", UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0.1, 0), subFrame, function()
        for i = 1, 30 do
            local ball = Instance.new("Part")
            ball.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            ball.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
            ball.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), 50, math.random(-50, 50))
            ball.Anchored = false
            ball.CanCollide = false
            ball.Name = "Guest"
            ball.Parent = workspace

            ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                    hit.Anchored = true
                    wait(4)
                    local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
                    explosion.Position = ball.Position
                    explosion.Parent = workspace
                    ball:Destroy()
                end
            end)
            wait(0.2)
        end
    end)
end)
